_comment: NitroFusion2 (1 step) - Text to Image. Export (API) format for a bitGen Studio image style.
2.729.0 (Tim: "can u add this please https://chendaryen.github.io/NitroFusion2.github.io/"). NitroFusion2 (Dar-Yen Chen, Yi-Zhe Song,
Apache-2.0) is Z-Image-Turbo distilled to 1-2 steps with an adversarial loss on the MMDiT's text stream - sharp text and fine detail in one step.
Derived from the authors' own ComfyUI workflow (github.com/ChenDarYen/NitroFusion2: workflows/nitrofusion2_1step.json): node types, widget
names and values taken from that file; its subgraph flattened (what Export (API) gives). ComfyUI's own nodes - no node pack.
MODELS (ComfyUI's OWN folders - Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ NitroFusion2 downloads them):
models/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors     (7.5 GB; CLIPLoader type lumina2 - Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo, Z-Image-Turbo's encoder)
models/vae/ae.safetensors                      (0.3 GB; the FLUX.1 VAE Z-Image uses)
1 step, cfg 1, euler / simple, shift 3 (ModelSamplingAuraFlow), a zeroed negative - the authors' settings. 1024 x 1024 (about 1 MP).
LoRAs: model-only (LoraLoaderModelOnly), 4 slots, bypassed when empty.
